subtitle: The banner appears at the top of the page, above the navigation. The most severe message speaks alone.
overrunNotice: Form pre-filled from “{session}”. Check the message and the display window before publishing.

scope.label: Scope
scope.hint: A whole-platform message appears on every page, including outside this event.

help.global: Everywhere, for everyone. Reserve it for platform-wide outages.
help.event: On the event and on all its activities.
help.event_day: On the activities of that day.
help.session: On this activity only, and on its public page.
help.organization: On the activities run by this organization.

kind.label: Kind
kind.hint: Vocabulary maintained by IFDD: add a term from the settings rather than slipping it into the message.

help.info: Quiet, dismissible banner. An extended call, a room change.
help.warning: Solid yellow. An activity running over, a late speaker.
help.error: Solid red, not dismissible. An interrupted broadcast, a cancellation.
help.critical: Solid red with a rule, not dismissible. The pavilion is down.

field.titleHint: Optional. Without a title, the message speaks alone — often more direct.
field.messageHint: Both languages are required: half the online audience reads English. Say what is happening, then what will happen.
field.actionUrlHint: Optional. A schedule page, an information note.
field.dismissibleHint: An incident and a major incident are never dismissible, whatever this setting says.

window.endHint: Fill it in as soon as you know: it is what removes the banner without anyone having to think about it.
window.endOpenHint: The banner will stay online until someone withdraws it by hand.

preview.title: Banner preview
preview.description: As it will appear at the top of the page, for the audience.
preview.empty: Write the message to see the preview.
preview.scheduledNotice: This message will only be shown from {date}.

unsaved: Message saved. It is not published: nobody sees it yet.

error.missing_target: The chosen scope requires a target.
error.missing_message: The message must be written in French and in English.
error.invalid_window: The end of display must be later than its start.
error.forbidden: Your account cannot publish messages on this event.

forbidden.scope: Publish an incident message, on this event

notFound.title: Message not found
notFound.description: This message does not exist, or it belongs to an event outside your scope.
